revision_summary: No fabricated/not_found quotes were found by the deterministic checker, and the core trajectory and outcome reads are sound. However, two cherry_pick_moments entries misuse schema classification labels in ways that would mislead a manager reading coaching categories: (1) the 'curiosity_creation_failure' label at ts 02:34 should be renamed to something like 'unadapted_verify_script' or mapped to schema_drift_detection — it currently borrows coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features, which means the opposite thing (avoiding over-explaining features, not misapplied verify questions). (2) The 'knowledge_gap' label at ts 02:45 should be reclassified — knowledge_gap_handling is defined in the schema as a REP-side failure mode (rep doesn't have an answer), not customer confusion; relabel as a verify-script mismatch or fold into the 02:34 entry as one continuous moment. Additionally, tighten the ambiguous 00:53 scope-creep call — the transcript line is genuinely unclear about what the rep is confirming, so the classification should carry a confidence caveat rather than reading as a clean scope-creep violation. Finally, consider surfacing the interest_reason_audit miss (customer's unprompted use-case at 00:40 never reflected back) as an explicit coaching_focus item, since it's a legitimate curiosity-anchor gap per bill_anchoring/curiosity philosophy and currently is only buried in one audit block.
